decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing the source's usability and auditability instruction; the presentation narrative is a separate communication objective and does not further change this candidate.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already captures communication of the investment story, financial viability, bankability, and investor attractiveness, so no additional MODIFY is required.
The presentation narrative does not change the existing specific requirement to demonstrate that availability-style payments are necessary for viability and bankability.
Requiring the model to present a persuasive viability and bankability narrative does not alter its calculation-integrity, error-correction, or credibility standards.
The source decision does not change the required Excel format or the prohibition on substituting the flawed PDF version.
The new presentation narrative does not modify the reference basis, provisional-input policy, or assumption-disclosure rules.
The source decision does not change the required shared-cost categories or their presentation as separate capex line items.

Although the source mentions showing project returns clearly, that dashboard communication obligation is already owned by the decision-maker dashboard; it does not change the candidate's equity-IRR calculation target.
The presentation narrative does not alter the required CCA classes, depreciation treatment, tax shield, or equity-return effects.
A clearer case for bankability does not change the provisional 55/45 financing structure, approximate interest rate, tranche structure, or mezzanine treatment.
The source decision does not resolve or modify the AUD basis, 2031 base year, or existing currency ambiguity.
The presentation narrative does not change the accepted opex range, network scope, provisional status, or exclusion of the Business Case Appendix opex figure.
